theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (τ : Fin n → Eucl P) (w : NVector (Eucl P) n), Orthonormal ℝ τ → (w = simpleNVector τ ∨ w = -simpleNVector τ) → (∀ b : Covector (Eucl P) n, |w b| ≤ ‖b‖) ∧ w ≠ 0
